purpose: HOLD: V3.2 full-corpus execution is disabled until MASTER + Behavior Handbook + owner complaint/order are mapped into an explicit evidence-parity and retrieval-coverage contract. Different reader mechanisms are allowed; different source-evidence completeness is forbidden.
hold_reason: KNOWN_INCOMPLETE_SCOPE_BEFORE_FULL_CORPUS: current V3.2 preserves full observation envelope and lifecycle/path structure but does not yet prove one-to-one coverage/retrievability for the complete behavior-reading requirements and manual/owner complaint set.
next_activation_gate: Enable only after CI for the exact source-field/source-row/provenance changes passes. The resulting 18-source run proves data/evidence retrieval parity only; it does not replace Machine 1 semantic behavior PASS.
benchmark_definition: PEKERJAAN_MEMBACA_PERILAKU_PASAR handbook plus source-grounded manual semantic outputs define the minimum evidence-completeness benchmark. Machine 1 and Machine 2 may use independent reading mechanisms, but neither may expose less source-supported evidence than this benchmark where that evidence exists in the canonical source.
parity_rule: Different mechanisms are allowed; different completeness of retrievable source-supported evidence is forbidden.
proof_note: The contract is ready. Corpus-wide proof remains false until a fresh 18-source run passes exact row/field/provenance reconciliation and second-run readback.
activation_reason: CI PASS on complete source-field retention, exact source-row segment preservation, source provenance binding, and evidence-retrieval parity contract. Run is authorized to prove 18-source corpus-wide data/evidence completeness. It does not replace Machine 1 semantic behavior PASS.
operational_recovery_note: Trigger after provisioning Python through actions/setup-python for NETWORK SERVICE runner. Same locked software revision, source scope, evidence contract, and checkpoint lineage.
service_runner_auto_recovery_note: Auto-rerun is permitted only when a completed failed run has no explicit failed step and retains interrupted/pending step state consistent with runner loss or power interruption. Explicit test/auth/runtime/reconciliation failures remain HOLD for diagnosis.
